reading: Fiberhub is a carrier-neutral colocation and network services provider operated by VegasNAP LLC since its founding in 2010, headquartered at its flagship LAS1 facility at 1110 Palms Airport Drive in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company also operates a second facility, SEA1, in Seattle, Washington. Fiberhub offers colocation configurations ranging from single 1U servers to full 42U cabinets and private cages of more than 200 square feet, alongside IP transit, hybrid cloud, and managed backup services, with connectivity options up to 100 gigabits per second. The company's public materials describe the corporate structure only as VegasNAP LLC doing business as Fiberhub, without disclosing founders or further investor detail. As a two-market carrier-neutral colocation provider, Fiberhub's profile in this registry is similar in scale and business model to other regional colocation specialists rather than the national wholesale or hyperscale developers, serving customers who need direct Las Vegas or Seattle market presence and carrier diversity rather than large power-dense campus capacity.
